question: Retrieve the most recent orders where the remarks mention “Cleanup”, sorted by order time from newest to oldest. Show me the first 10 order numbers.
SQL: SELECT soh.salesorderid AS id_external FROM ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERHEADER soh WHERE soh.comment LIKE '%Cleanup%' ORDER BY soh.orderdate DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Retrieve the new order numbers within the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', sorted by order time in descending order, and first look at the top 10 records.
SQL: SELECT soh.salesorderid AS id_external FROM ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERHEADER soh WHERE soh.orderdate >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND soh.orderdate < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' ORDER BY soh.orderdate DESC LIMIT 10;

question: List the orders with current status '5'. I want to see the latest batch first (top 10).
SQL: SELECT soh.salesorderid AS id_external FROM ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERHEADER soh WHERE soh.STATUS = '5' ORDER BY soh.orderdate DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', which orders have a status of '5' and contain "good" in the remarks? Please return the latest 10 orders.
SQL: SELECT soh.salesorderid AS id_external FROM ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERHEADER soh WHERE soh.orderdate >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND soh.orderdate < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' AND soh.STATUS = 5 AND soh.comment LIKE CONCAT('%', '%good%', '%') ORDER BY soh.orderdate DESC LIMIT 10;

question: How many orders did we place between '2001-01-01 00:00:00' and '2026-01-31 23:59:59'?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERHEADER soh WHERE soh.orderdate >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND soh.orderdate < '2026-01-31 23:59:59';

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', how many distinct sales regions did the orders cover? I want to see the coverage.
SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT soh.territoryid) AS distinct_entity_cnt FROM ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERHEADER soh WHERE soh.orderdate >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND soh.orderdate < '2026-01-31 23:59:59';

question: What is the total amount payable for orders during the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59'?
SQL: SELECT SUM(soh.totaldue) AS total_amount FROM ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERHEADER soh WHERE soh.orderdate >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND soh.orderdate < '2026-01-31 23:59:59';

question: What is the average amount paid per order between '2001-01-01 00:00:00' and '2026-01-31 23:59:59'?
SQL: SELECT AVG(soh.totaldue) AS avg_amount FROM ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERHEADER soh WHERE soh.orderdate >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND soh.orderdate < '2026-01-31 23:59:59';

question: During the period from 2001-01-01 to 2024-01-31, which product line is the most popular? Rank the top 10 by transaction detail volume.
SQL: SELECT p.productline AS category_topic, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERHEADER soh JOIN ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERDETAIL sod ON sod.salesorderid = soh.salesorderid JOIN ADVENTUREWORKS.PRODUCT p ON p.productid = sod.productid WHERE soh.orderdate >= '2001-01-01' AND soh.orderdate < '2024-01-31' GROUP BY p.productline ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: During the period from 2001-01-01 to 2024-01-31, how many distinct products (deduplicated by product ID) were sold per product line? Return the top 10 with the highest counts.
SQL: SELECT p.productline AS category_topic, COUNT(DISTINCT sod.productid) AS distinct_entity_cnt FROM ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERHEADER soh JOIN ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERDETAIL sod ON sod.salesorderid = soh.salesorderid JOIN ADVENTUREWORKS.PRODUCT p ON p.productid = sod.productid WHERE soh.orderdate >= '2001-01-01' AND soh.orderdate < '2024-01-31' GROUP BY p.productline ORDER BY distinct_entity_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Which sales territories (Territory Name) had the highest order counts between '2001-01-01 00:00:00' and '2026-01-31 23:59:59'? Give me the top 10 list.
SQL: SELECT st.name AS name_entity, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERHEADER soh JOIN ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESTERRITORY st ON st.territoryid = soh.territoryid WHERE soh.orderdate >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND soh.orderdate < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', summarize the transaction amounts by sales region. What are the top 10 regions with the highest revenue contribution?
SQL: SELECT st.name AS name_entity, SUM(soh.totaldue) AS total_amount FROM ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERHEADER soh JOIN ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESTERRITORY st ON st.territoryid = soh.territoryid WHERE soh.orderdate >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND soh.orderdate < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Which countries/regions do most orders come from during the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59'? List the top 10 by order count.
SQL: SELECT st.countryregioncode AS location, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERHEADER soh JOIN ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESTERRITORY st ON st.territoryid = soh.territoryid WHERE soh.orderdate >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND soh.orderdate < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY st.countryregioncode ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Between '2001-01-01 00:00:00' and '2026-01-31 23:59:59', which salespersons had the most orders? Top 10 by order count.
SQL: SELECT soh.salespersonid AS rel_person, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERHEADER soh WHERE soh.orderdate >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND soh.orderdate < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY soh.salespersonid ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Please show me the daily order trend for the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59': how many orders were placed each day?
SQL: SELECT DATE(soh.orderdate) AS day, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERHEADER soh WHERE soh.orderdate >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND soh.orderdate < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day;

question: Pull the monthly transaction amount trend for the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59': what is the total TotalDue for each month?
SQL: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(soh.orderdate, '%Y-%m-01') AS month, SUM(soh.totaldue) AS total_amount FROM ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERHEADER soh WHERE soh.orderdate >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND soh.orderdate < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

question: Want to see structural changes: during '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', how active is the trading of each product line per day (measured by order details)?
SQL: SELECT DATE( soh.orderdate) AS day, p.productline AS category_topic, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERHEADER soh JOIN ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERDETAIL sod ON sod.salesorderid = soh.salesorderid JOIN ADVENTUREWORKS.PRODUCT p ON p.productid = sod.productid WHERE soh.orderdate >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND soh.orderdate < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY day, p.productline ORDER BY day, event_cnt DESC;

question: Which sales regions had order volumes reaching/exceeding 10 during the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59'? List these "qualified regions" in descending order of order volume.
SQL: SELECT st.name AS name_entity, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERHEADER soh JOIN ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESTERRITORY st ON st.territoryid = soh.territoryid WHERE soh.orderdate >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND soh.orderdate < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY st.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY event_cnt DESC;

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', which sales region has the highest average transaction value (average TotalDue)? Show me the top 10 regions.
SQL: SELECT st.name AS name_entity, AVG(soh.totaldue) AS avg_amount FROM ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERHEADER soh JOIN ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESTERRITORY st ON st.territoryid = soh.territoryid WHERE soh.orderdate >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND soh.orderdate < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' AND soh.totaldue IS NOT NULL GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY avg_amount DESC LIMIT 10;

question: In product reviews from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', which products have the most mentions of “good”? List the top 10 product names.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT p.NAME AS name_entity FROM ADVENTUREWORKS.PRODUCTREVIEW pr JOIN ADVENTUREWORKS.PRODUCT p ON p.productid = pr.productid WHERE pr.reviewdate >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND pr.reviewdate < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' AND pr.comments LIKE '%good%' ORDER BY p.NAME LIMIT 10;

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', which product lines had transaction activity significantly higher than overall average (based on order detail granularity)? List the top 10 by volume from high to low.
SQL: WITH topic_cnt AS ( SELECT p.productline AS topic, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERHEADER soh JOIN ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERDETAIL sod ON sod.salesorderid = soh.salesorderid JOIN ADVENTUREWORKS.PRODUCT p ON p.productid = sod.productid WHERE soh.orderdate >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND soh.orderdate < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY p.productline ), avg_cnt AS ( SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM topic_cnt ) SELECT topic, cnt FROM topic_cnt WHERE cnt > (SELECT avg_cnt FROM avg_cnt) ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', I want to see the sales structure: which salespeople are most active on which product lines? List the top 10 combinations ranked by the number of deals per "person × product line".
SQL: SELECT soh.salespersonid AS rel_person, p.productline AS category_topic, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERHEADER soh JOIN ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERDETAIL sod ON sod.salesorderid = soh.salesorderid JOIN ADVENTUREWORKS.PRODUCT p ON p.productid = sod.productid WHERE soh.orderdate >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND soh.orderdate < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY soh.salespersonid, p.productline ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Help me look up the list of flight numbers scheduled to depart between '2001-01-01 00:00:00' and '2026-01-31 23:59:59', and find the most recent 10 records.
SQL: SELECT f.flight_no AS id_external FROM AIRLINES.FLIGHTS f WHERE f.scheduled_departure >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND f.scheduled_departure < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' ORDER BY f.scheduled_departure DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Filter out the flights with status 'Scheduled'. I want to see the flight numbers of the first 10 flights with the earliest scheduled departure.
SQL: SELECT f.flight_no AS id_external FROM AIRLINES.FLIGHTS f WHERE f.status = 'Scheduled' ORDER BY f.scheduled_departure DESC LIMIT 10;

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', how many flights were scheduled to depart in total?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM AIRLINES.FLIGHTS f WHERE f.scheduled_departure >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND f.scheduled_departure < '2026-01-31 23:59:59';

question: How many distinct flight numbers were actually covered during the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59'?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tf.flight_id) AS distinct_entity_cnt FROM AIRLINES.TICKET_FLIGHTS tf JOIN AIRLINES.FLIGHTS f ON f.flight_id = tf.flight_id WHERE f.scheduled_departure >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND f.scheduled_departure < '2026-01-31 23:59:59';

question: What is the total sales amount generated by bookings during '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59'?
SQL: SELECT SUM(b.total_amount) AS total_amount FROM AIRLINES.BOOKINGS b WHERE b.book_date >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND b.book_date < '2026-01-31 23:59:59';

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', what is the approximate average amount per order for Bookings?
SQL: SELECT AVG(b.total_amount) AS avg_amount FROM AIRLINES.BOOKINGS b WHERE b.book_date >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND b.book_date < '2026-01-31 23:59:59';

question: Which are the top 10 categories by ticket sales record count under cabin conditions during the period from 2001-01-01 00:00:00 to 2026-01-31 23:59:59?
SQL: SELECT tf.fare_conditions AS category_topic, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM AIRLINES.TICKET_FLIGHTS tf JOIN AIRLINES.FLIGHTS f ON f.flight_id = tf.flight_id WHERE f.scheduled_departure >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND f.scheduled_departure < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY tf.fare_conditions ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', how many distinct flight numbers are covered by each cabin class? List the top 10 cabin classes.
SQL: SELECT tf.fare_conditions AS category_topic, COUNT(DISTINCT tf.flight_id) AS distinct_entity_cnt FROM AIRLINES.TICKET_FLIGHTS tf JOIN AIRLINES.FLIGHTS f ON f.flight_id = tf.flight_id WHERE f.scheduled_departure >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND f.scheduled_departure < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY tf.fare_conditions ORDER BY distinct_entity_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', which aircraft types hold the most flights? Give me the top 10 types.
SQL: SELECT a.model AS name_entity, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM AIRLINES.FLIGHTS f JOIN AIRLINES.AIRCRAFTS_DATA a ON a.aircraft_code = f.aircraft_code WHERE f.scheduled_departure >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND f.scheduled_departure < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY a.model ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', from the perspective of ticket revenue, which aircraft types contributed the most? Take the top 10 by aircraft type.
SQL: SELECT a.model AS name_entity, SUM(tf.amount) AS total_amount FROM AIRLINES.FLIGHTS f JOIN AIRLINES.TICKET_FLIGHTS tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id JOIN AIRLINES.AIRCRAFTS_DATA a ON a.aircraft_code = f.aircraft_code WHERE f.scheduled_departure >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND f.scheduled_departure < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY a.model ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 10;

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', which passengers have the most ticket purchase/issue counts? Get the top 10 by passenger_id.
SQL: SELECT t.passenger_id AS rel_person, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM AIRLINES.TICKETS t JOIN AIRLINES.BOOKINGS b ON b.book_ref = t.book_ref WHERE b.book_date >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND b.book_date < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY t.passenger_id ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: View the flight scheduled departure volume by day for the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59': How many flights are there per day? Sort by date in ascending order.
SQL: SELECT DATE(f.scheduled_departure) AS day, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM AIRLINES.FLIGHTS f WHERE f.scheduled_departure >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND f.scheduled_departure < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day;

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', summarize the reserved sales amount for Bookings by month. What is the total for each month? Sort by month.
SQL: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(b.book_date, '%Y-%m-01') AS month, SUM(b.total_amount) AS total_amount FROM AIRLINES.BOOKINGS b WHERE b.book_date >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND b.book_date < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

question: I want to view the change in cabin structure: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', what are the daily ticket sales for each cabin class? Sort by date and sales volume.
SQL: SELECT DATE( f.scheduled_departure) AS day, tf.fare_conditions AS category_topic, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM AIRLINES.TICKET_FLIGHTS tf JOIN AIRLINES.FLIGHTS f ON f.flight_id = tf.flight_id WHERE f.scheduled_departure >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND f.scheduled_departure < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY day, tf.fare_conditions ORDER BY day, event_cnt DESC;

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', which aircraft types qualify as “frequently flight” (with no fewer than 10 flights)? List them in descending order by flight count.
SQL: SELECT a.model AS name_entity, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM AIRLINES.FLIGHTS f JOIN AIRLINES.AIRCRAFTS_DATA a ON a.aircraft_code = f.aircraft_code WHERE f.scheduled_departure >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND f.scheduled_departure < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY a.model HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY event_cnt DESC;

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', analyze the average ticket amount by aircraft type: which aircraft types have a higher average ticket price (amount)? Retrieve the top 10 aircraft types.
SQL: SELECT a.model AS name_entity, AVG(tf.amount) AS avg_amount FROM AIRLINES.FLIGHTS f JOIN AIRLINES.TICKET_FLIGHTS tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id JOIN AIRLINES.AIRCRAFTS_DATA a ON a.aircraft_code = f.aircraft_code WHERE f.scheduled_departure >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND f.scheduled_departure < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' AND tf.amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.model ORDER BY avg_amount DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Between '2017-06-01 00:00:00' and '2017-07-31 23:59:59', which cabin classes had ticket sales volume greater than or equal to the overall average? List the top 10 cabin classes by volume in descending order.
SQL: WITH topic_cnt AS ( SELECT tf.fare_conditions AS topic, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM AIRLINES.TICKET_FLIGHTS tf JOIN AIRLINES.FLIGHTS f ON f.flight_id = tf.flight_id WHERE f.scheduled_departure >= '2017-06-01 00:00:00' AND f.scheduled_departure < '2017-07-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY tf.fare_conditions ), avg_cnt AS ( SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM topic_cnt ) SELECT topic, cnt FROM topic_cnt WHERE cnt >= (SELECT avg_cnt FROM avg_cnt) ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: What is the ticket purchase structure for passengers during the period from '2017-07-01 00:00:00' to '2017-12-31 23:59:59'? When counting ticket segments by passenger (passenger_id) and cabin class, what are the top 10 most typical combinations?
SQL: SELECT t.passenger_id AS rel_person, tf.fare_conditions AS category_topic, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM AIRLINES.TICKETS t JOIN AIRLINES.TICKET_FLIGHTS tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no JOIN AIRLINES.BOOKINGS b ON b.book_ref = t.book_ref WHERE b.book_date >= '2017-07-01 00:00:00' AND b.book_date < '2017-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY t.passenger_id, tf.fare_conditions ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: What is the ticket revenue (amount) for each cabin class during the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59'? Show the top 10 by revenue.
SQL: SELECT tf.fare_conditions AS category_topic, SUM(tf.amount) AS total_amount FROM AIRLINES.TICKET_FLIGHTS tf JOIN AIRLINES.FLIGHTS f ON f.flight_id = tf.flight_id WHERE f.scheduled_departure >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND f.scheduled_departure < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY tf.fare_conditions ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Among the cabins, which ones have cumulative ticket revenue reaching/exceeding 1000 during the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59'? Sort by revenue from high to low.
SQL: SELECT tf.fare_conditions AS category_topic, SUM(tf.amount) AS total_amount FROM AIRLINES.TICKET_FLIGHTS tf JOIN AIRLINES.FLIGHTS f ON f.flight_id = tf.flight_id WHERE f.scheduled_departure >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND f.scheduled_departure < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY tf.fare_conditions HAVING SUM(tf.amount) >= 1000 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', view the impact of flight operation status by cabin class: for the ticket segments corresponding to each cabin class, what proportion fall on flights in "Business" status? Take the top 10 cabin classes with the highest proportions.
SQL: SELECT tf.fare_conditions AS category_topic, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN f.status = 'Business' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS ratio_in_status FROM AIRLINES.TICKET_FLIGHTS tf JOIN AIRLINES.FLIGHTS f ON f.flight_id = tf.flight_id WHERE f.scheduled_departure >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND f.scheduled_departure < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY tf.fare_conditions ORDER BY ratio_in_status DESC LIMIT 10;

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', which aircraft type generates the highest ticket revenue in each cabin class? I want to see the highest revenue flight for each cabin class. Please give me the top 10.
SQL: WITH agg AS ( SELECT tf.fare_conditions AS topic, a.model AS entity, SUM(tf.amount) AS total_amount FROM AIRLINES.FLIGHTS f JOIN AIRLINES.TICKET_FLIGHTS tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id JOIN AIRLINES.AIRCRAFTS_DATA a ON a.aircraft_code = f.aircraft_code WHERE f.scheduled_departure >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND f.scheduled_departure < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY tf.fare_conditions, a.model ), ranked AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY topic ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS rn FROM agg ) SELECT topic, entity, total_amount FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 10;

question: I'd like to confirm the size of the bowling league tournament match (archive) table: how many match records are there in total?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_cnt FROM BOWLINGLEAGUE.TOURNEY_MATCHES_ARCHIVE tma;

question: How many distinct match numbers are there in the Bowling League Tournament Matchups (Archive)?

question: In the bowling league, based on player performance records, how many distinct matches were involved in total?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bs.MatchID) AS distinct_entity_cnt FROM BOWLINGLEAGUE.BOWLER_SCORES bs;

question: I want to see which editions of the bowling league championship have the most matchups: count matches by TourneyID, show the top 10.

question: I want to quickly scan which table names and their frequencies are recorded in the auto-increment sequence table in the bowling league database, and give me the Top 10 (for ops/data reconciliation purposes).
SQL: SELECT ss.name AS name_entity, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM BOWLINGLEAGUE.SQLITE_SEQUENCE ss GROUP BY ss.name ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: I want to search "Bowlers" in the bowling league sequence table to see if there is a match, and give me the first 10 matching seq values.
SQL: SELECT distinct ss.seq AS id_external FROM BOWLINGLEAGUE.SQLITE_SEQUENCE ss WHERE ss.name LIKE '%Bowlers%' ORDER BY ss.seq LIMIT 10;

question: In the bowling league, I want to view attendence by team dimension: how many games have the players of each TeamID played in total? Give me the Top 10.
SQL: SELECT b.TeamID AS rel_entity, SUM(b.BowlerGamesBowled) AS total_quantity FROM BOWLINGLEAGUE.BOWLERS b GROUP BY b.TeamID ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 10;

question: In a bowling league, I want to see the main distribution of tournament matchups across lane combinations: count matchups by Lanes, top 10.
SQL: SELECT tma.Lanes AS category_topic, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM BOWLINGLEAGUE.TOURNEY_MATCHES_ARCHIVE tma GROUP BY tma.Lanes ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Help me count how many trial records are in the COVID-related clinical trial data.

question: Please help me count how many distinct trial registration numbers are in the COVID-related clinical trial data.

question: Count the total number of distinct external detail page links in the COVID-related clinical trial data.

question: Show me the number of clinical trial records for each registration platform, and list the top 10 in descending order by count.
SQL: SELECT ct.registry AS rel_entity, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM DIMENSIONS_AI_COVID19.CLINICAL_TRIALS ct GROUP BY ct.registry ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Show me the top 10 most frequent clinical trial titles, sorted by count from highest to lowest.
SQL: SELECT ct.title AS name_entity, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM DIMENSIONS_AI_COVID19.CLINICAL_TRIALS ct GROUP BY ct.title ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Please help me find clinical trials with "good" in the title, sorted by trial registration number, and give me the top 10.
SQL: SELECT distinct ct.id AS id_external FROM DIMENSIONS_AI_COVID19.CLINICAL_TRIALS ct WHERE ct.title LIKE '%good%' ORDER BY ct.id LIMIT 10;

question: Show me the cumulative enrollment numbers for different study types, sorted in descending order by count, and return the top 10.
SQL: SELECT ct.study_type AS rel_entity, SUM(ct.study_participants) AS total_quantity FROM DIMENSIONS_AI_COVID19.CLINICAL_TRIALS ct GROUP BY ct.study_type ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Show me the number of clinical trial records for each study type, and give me the top 10 study types sorted by count in descending order.
SQL: SELECT ct.study_type AS category_topic, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM DIMENSIONS_AI_COVID19.CLINICAL_TRIALS ct GROUP BY ct.study_type ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Please show me which clinical trial titles have the highest average enrollment numbers, and give me the top 10 sorted from high to low average enrollment.
SQL: SELECT ct.title AS name_entity, AVG(ct.study_participants) AS avg_quantity FROM DIMENSIONS_AI_COVID19.CLINICAL_TRIALS ct WHERE ct.study_participants IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ct.title ORDER BY avg_quantity DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Help me find the transactions whose transaction input data contains "0x", and give me the latest 10 transaction hashes in reverse chronological order.
SQL: SELECT tr.transaction_hash AS id_external FROM ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRANSACTIONS tx JOIN ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRACES tr ON tr.transaction_hash = tx.hash WHERE tx.input LIKE '%0x%' ORDER BY tx.block_timestamp DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Please find transactions that occurred between January 1, 2015 and January 31, 2020, sort them in descending order by time, and provide the transaction hashes of the latest 10 transactions.
SQL: SELECT tr.transaction_hash AS id_external FROM ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRANSACTIONS tx JOIN ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRACES tr ON tr.transaction_hash = tx.hash WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(tx.block_timestamp / 1000000) >= '2015-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(tx.block_timestamp / 1000000) < '2020-01-31 23:59:59' ORDER BY tx.block_timestamp DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Retrieve successfully executed transactions and list the latest 10 transaction hashes in descending order by time.
SQL: SELECT tr.transaction_hash AS id_external FROM ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRANSACTIONS tx JOIN ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRACES tr ON tr.transaction_hash = tx.hash WHERE tx.receipt_status = 1 ORDER BY tx.block_timestamp DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Help me find transactions executed successfully between "2015-01-01" and "2020-01-31" that contain "0x" in the transaction input data, sorted by time in descending order, and return the most recent 10 transaction hashes.
SQL: SELECT tr.transaction_hash AS id_external FROM ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRANSACTIONS tx JOIN ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRACES tr ON tr.transaction_hash = tx.hash WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(tx.block_timestamp / 1000000) >= '2015-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(tx.block_timestamp / 1000000) < '2020-01-31 23:59:59' AND tx.receipt_status = 1 AND tx.input LIKE CONCAT('%', '0x', '%') ORDER BY tx.block_timestamp DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Help me count the total number of transactions between January 1, 2001 and January 31, 2026.
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRANSACTIONS tx JOIN ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRACES tr ON tr.transaction_hash = tx.hash WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(tx.block_timestamp / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(tx.block_timestamp / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59';

question: Count the number of distinct called addresses that have participated in transactions between January 1, 2001 and January 31, 2026.
SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tr.to_address) AS distinct_entity_cnt FROM ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRANSACTIONS tx JOIN ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRACES tr ON tr.transaction_hash = tx.hash WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(tx.block_timestamp / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(tx.block_timestamp / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59';

question: Calculate the total amount of currency transferred out in transactions between January 1, 2001 and January 31, 2026.
SQL: SELECT SUM(tx.value) AS total_amount FROM ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRANSACTIONS tx JOIN ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRACES tr ON tr.transaction_hash = tx.hash WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(tx.block_timestamp / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(tx.block_timestamp / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59';

question: Calculate the average amount of currency transferred per transaction and the average Gas consumed between January 1, 2001 and January 31, 2026.
SQL: SELECT AVG(tx.value) AS avg_amount, AVG(tx.receipt_gas_used) AS avg_quantity FROM ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRANSACTIONS tx JOIN ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRACES tr ON tr.transaction_hash = tx.hash WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(tx.block_timestamp / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(tx.block_timestamp / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59';

question: Please help me count how many times each transaction invocation type occurred between January 1, 2001 and January 31, 2026, and give me the top 10 sorted by frequency from highest to lowest.
SQL: SELECT tr.trace_type AS category_topic, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRACES tr WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(tr.block_timestamp / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(tr.block_timestamp / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY tr.trace_type ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Show me the top 10 transaction call types, ranked by the number of distinct called addresses involved, for the period from January 1, 2001 to January 31, 2026, in descending order by count.
SQL: SELECT tr.trace_type AS category_topic, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.to_address) AS distinct_entity_cnt FROM ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRACES tr WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(tr.block_timestamp / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(tr.block_timestamp / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY tr.trace_type ORDER BY distinct_entity_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Help me check which tokens had the most active transfers between January 1, 2015 and January 31, 2020, and give me the top 10 token names ranked by transfer count from high to low.
SQL: SELECT tk.name AS name_entity, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TOKEN_TRANSFERS tt JOIN ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TOKENS tk ON tt.token_address = tk.address WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(tt.block_timestamp / 1000000) >= '2015-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(tt.block_timestamp / 1000000) < '2020-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY tk.name ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Check for me, between January 1, 2015, and January 31, 2020, which tokens had the highest total transfer amount, and give me the top 10 token names in descending order by transfer amount.
SQL: SELECT tk.name AS name_entity, SUM(CAST(tt.value AS DECIMAL(65, 0))) AS total_amount FROM ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TOKEN_TRANSFERS tt JOIN ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TOKENS tk ON tt.token_address = tk.address WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(tt.block_timestamp / 1000000) >= '2015-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(tt.block_timestamp / 1000000) < '2020-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY tk.name ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 10;

question: I would like to see the daily change in transaction volume between January 1, 2016 and January 31, 2020, showing the number of transactions per day.
SQL: SELECT DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(tx.block_timestamp / 1000000.0)) AS day, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRANSACTIONS tx JOIN ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRACES tr ON tr.transaction_hash = tx.hash WHERE tx.block_timestamp >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2016-01-01 00:00:00') * 1000000.0 AND tx.block_timestamp < UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2020-01-31 23:59:59') * 1000000.0 GROUP BY day ORDER BY day;

question: I would like to see how many times each different transaction invocation type occurred per day between January 1, 2001 and January 31, 2026.
SQL: SELECT DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(tr.block_timestamp / 1000000.0)) AS day, tr.trace_type AS category_topic, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRACES tr WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(tr.block_timestamp / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(tr.block_timestamp / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY day, tr.trace_type ORDER BY day, event_cnt DESC;

question: Help me find the tokens that had at least 5 transfers between January 1, 2015 and January 31, 2020, and list them in descending order by transfer count.
SQL: SELECT tk.name AS name_entity, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TOKEN_TRANSFERS tt JOIN ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TOKENS tk ON tt.token_address = tk.address WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(tt.block_timestamp / 1000000) >= '2015-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(tt.block_timestamp / 1000000) < '2020-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY tk.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY event_cnt DESC;

question: Check for me between January 1, 2015 and January 31, 2020, which tokens have the highest average transfer amount per transaction, and give me the top 10 token names sorted by average transfer amount from high to low.
SQL: SELECT tk.name AS name_entity, AVG(CAST(tt.value AS DECIMAL)) AS avg_amount FROM ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TOKEN_TRANSFERS tt JOIN ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TOKENS tk ON tt.token_address = tk.address WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(tt.block_timestamp / 1000000) >= '2015-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(tt.block_timestamp / 1000000) < '2020-01-31 23:59:59' AND tt.value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tk.name ORDER BY avg_amount DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Find the types between 2001-01-01 and 2026-01-31 whose call count is higher than the average call count of all transaction call types, and give me the top 10 sorted by call count in descending order.
SQL: WITH topic_cnt AS ( SELECT tr.trace_type AS topic, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRACES tr WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(tr.block_timestamp / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(tr.block_timestamp / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY tr.trace_type ), avg_cnt AS ( SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM topic_cnt ) SELECT topic, cnt FROM topic_cnt WHERE cnt > (SELECT avg_cnt FROM avg_cnt) ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Please show me the total amount of native token transfers for different transaction call types between January 1, 2015 and January 31, 2020, and give me the top 10 sorted by total amount in descending order.
SQL: SELECT tr.trace_type AS category_topic, SUM(tx.value) AS total_amount FROM ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRANSACTIONS tx JOIN ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRACES tr ON tr.transaction_hash = tx.hash WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(tx.block_timestamp / 1000000) >= '2015-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(tx.block_timestamp / 1000000) < '2020-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY tr.trace_type ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Help me find which transaction call types had a total currency transfer amount exceeding 1000 between January 1, 1970 and January 31, 1978.
SQL: SELECT tr.trace_type AS category_topic, SUM(tx.value) AS total_amount FROM ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRANSACTIONS tx JOIN ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRACES tr ON tr.transaction_hash = tx.hash WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(tx.block_timestamp / 1000000) >= '1970-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(tx.block_timestamp / 1000000) < '1978-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY tr.trace_type HAVING SUM(tx.value) >= 1000 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

question: Please check the transaction success rates for different transaction call types between January 1, 2015 and January 31, 2020.
SQL: SELECT tr.trace_type AS category_topic, SUM( tx.receipt_status ) / COUNT(*) AS ratio_in_status FROM ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRANSACTIONS tx JOIN ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRACES tr ON tr.transaction_hash = tx.hash WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(tx.block_timestamp/ 1000000) >= '2015-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(tx.block_timestamp/ 1000000) < '2020-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY tr.trace_type ORDER BY ratio_in_status DESC;

question: Calculate the total gas consumed by on-chain transactions between January 1, 2001 and January 31, 2026.

question: Show me the top 10 transaction call types by total gas consumed between January 1, 2015 and January 31, 2020, ordered from highest to lowest.
SQL: SELECT tr.trace_type AS category_topic, SUM(tx.receipt_gas_used) AS total_quantity FROM ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRANSACTIONS tx JOIN ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN.TRACES tr ON tr.transaction_hash = tx.hash WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(tx.block_timestamp / 1000000) >= '2015-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(tx.block_timestamp / 1000000) < '2020-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY tr.trace_type ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 10;

question: I want to check the feature IDs that have change records during the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59' (according to OSM historical timestamps), and view the first 10 records in reverse chronological order.

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', how many change events were recorded in total by the OSM history layers?

question: How many distinct changesets were involved in node changes during the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59'? (deduplicate by changeset)

question: During the period from 2001-01-01 00:00:00 to 2026-01-31 23:59:59, which feature categories (layer_class, e.g., traffic) changed most frequently in OSM history records? Provide the top 10.

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', which specific layer feature names (layer_name, such as parking) had the most active changes? Give me the Top 10.
SQL: SELECT hl.layer_name AS name_entity, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM GEO_OPENSTREETMAP_WORLDPOP.GEO_OPENSTREETMAP_HISTORY_LAYERS hl WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(hl.osm_timestamp / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(hl.osm_timestamp / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY hl.layer_name ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: In the period from '2021-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', I want to identify which spatial element geometries (geometry) have the most frequent changes in their corresponding layer records (counted by occurrence). First, give me the top 10 geometry objects.
SQL: SELECT pf.geometry AS location, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM GEO_OPENSTREETMAP_WORLDPOP.GEO_OPENSTREETMAP_PLANET_LAYERS pl JOIN GEO_OPENSTREETMAP_WORLDPOP.GEO_OPENSTREETMAP_PLANET_FEATURES pf ON pl.osm_way_id = pf.osm_way_id WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(pl.osm_timestamp / 1000000) >= '2021-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(pl.osm_timestamp / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY pf.geometry ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: I want to see the daily rhythm of OSM layer changes from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59': how many historical changes are recorded per day?

question: I want to split by day and see the change heat of different element categories (layer_class): from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', how many changes were recorded for each category each day?

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', which layer feature names (layer_name) belong to "frequently change" (with at least 10 change records)? List them in descending order of frequency.
SQL: SELECT hl.layer_name AS name_entity, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM GEO_OPENSTREETMAP_WORLDPOP.GEO_OPENSTREETMAP_HISTORY_LAYERS hl WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(hl.osm_timestamp / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(hl.osm_timestamp / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY hl.layer_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY event_cnt DESC;

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', which major element categories (layer_class) have a change frequency higher than the "overall average"? List the top 10 active categories.
SQL: WITH topic_cnt AS ( SELECT hl.layer_class AS topic, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM GEO_OPENSTREETMAP_WORLDPOP.GEO_OPENSTREETMAP_HISTORY_LAYERS hl WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(hl.osm_timestamp / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(hl.osm_timestamp / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY hl.layer_class ), avg_cnt AS ( SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM topic_cnt ) SELECT topic, cnt FROM topic_cnt WHERE cnt > (SELECT avg_cnt FROM avg_cnt) ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: I want to quickly spot-check the billing application numbers of a batch of receivable documents based on the account creation date ('2001-01-01 00:00:00' ~ '2026-01-31 23:59:59'), and first give me the top 10 records sorted by the latest account creation date in descending order.

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59' (based on account creation date), how many new records were added to the accounts receivable ledger in total?

question: How many distinct projects (deduplicate by project_id) generated accounts receivable during the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59'?

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59' (based on the account creation date), what is the cumulative amount of confirmed revenue (converted to functional currency)?

question: For the receivables newly added between 2001-01-01 00:00:00 and 2026-01-31 23:59:59, what are the approximate average recognized revenue per transaction (in local currency) and average overdue days?

question: During the period from 2001-01-01 00:00:00 to 2026-01-31 23:59:59, which customer types are primarily associated with new receivables? Provide the top 10 by receivable count.

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', which customer companies contributed the highest recognized revenue (in base currency)? Summarize the top 10 by customer dimension.

question: I want to analyze the customer type structure by day: from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', how many new receivables were created for each customer type per day?

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', which customers belong to "frequently receivable customer" (with at least 10 receivable transactions)? List them in descending order by transaction count.
SQL: SELECT ar.company_name AS name_entity, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM ods_crm.crm_account_receivable ar WHERE ar.make_account_date >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND ar.make_account_date < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY ar.company_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY event_cnt DESC;

question: Which customers have the highest average single receivable confirmed revenue (in base currency) during the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59'? Filter out null values and give me the Top 10.
SQL: SELECT ar.company_name AS name_entity, AVG(ar.income_amount_domestic) AS avg_amount FROM ods_crm.crm_account_receivable ar WHERE ar.make_account_date >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND ar.make_account_date < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' AND ar.income_amount_domestic IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ar.company_name ORDER BY avg_amount DESC LIMIT 10;

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', which customer types have a higher number of new receivables than the overall average? List these more active customer types (top 10).
SQL: WITH topic_cnt AS ( SELECT ar.customer_type AS topic, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ods_crm.crm_account_receivable ar WHERE ar.make_account_date >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND ar.make_account_date < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY ar.customer_type ), avg_cnt AS ( SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM topic_cnt ) SELECT topic, cnt FROM topic_cnt WHERE cnt > (SELECT avg_cnt FROM avg_cnt) ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', I want to see the accounts receivable formation intensity of "Project Manager × Customer Type": Which responsible persons have the highest concentration of new accounts receivable in specific customer types? Give me the top 10 combinations.
SQL: SELECT ar.project_mgr_id AS rel_person, ar.customer_type AS category_topic, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM ods_crm.crm_account_receivable ar WHERE ar.make_account_date >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND ar.make_account_date < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY ar.project_mgr_id, ar.customer_type ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', what is the recognized revenue (base currency) contributed by different customer types? Give me the top 10 by amount.
SQL: SELECT ar.customer_type AS category_topic, SUM(ar.income_amount_domestic) AS total_amount FROM ods_crm.crm_account_receivable ar WHERE ar.make_account_date >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND ar.make_account_date < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY ar.customer_type ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 10;

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', which customer types have cumulative recognized revenue (in base currency) exceeding 1000? I want to identify the customer types with significant contributions.
SQL: SELECT ar.customer_type AS category_topic, SUM(ar.income_amount_domestic) AS total_amount FROM ods_crm.crm_account_receivable ar WHERE ar.make_account_date >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND ar.make_account_date < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY ar.customer_type HAVING SUM(ar.income_amount_domestic) >= 1000 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

question: I want to find the "most contributed customer" by customer type: within the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', which customer company has the highest recognized revenue (in base currency) in each customer type?
SQL: WITH agg AS ( SELECT ar.customer_type AS topic, ar.company_name AS entity, SUM(ar.income_amount_domestic) AS total_amount FROM ods_crm.crm_account_receivable ar WHERE ar.make_account_date >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND ar.make_account_date < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY ar.customer_type, ar.company_name ), ranked AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY topic ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS rn FROM agg ) SELECT topic, entity, total_amount FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 10;

question: What is the total number of overdue days for the newly added receivables during the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59'? I want to get a rough view of the overdue pressure of the newly added receivables.
SQL: SELECT SUM(ar.overdue_days) AS total_quantity FROM ods_crm.crm_account_receivable ar WHERE ar.make_account_date >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND ar.make_account_date < '2026-01-31 23:59:59';

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', what is the overdue days pressure (total overdue days) for different customer types? Show me the top 10.
SQL: SELECT ar.customer_type AS category_topic, SUM(ar.overdue_days) AS total_quantity FROM ods_crm.crm_account_receivable ar WHERE ar.make_account_date >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND ar.make_account_date < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY ar.customer_type ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 10;

question: I want to first understand the scale of the PyPI distribution metadata table: how many distribution records are there?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_cnt FROM PYPI.DISTRIBUTION_METADATA dm;

question: In the PyPI distribution package metadata, how many distinct SHA256 artifact fingerprints (deduplicated by sha256_digest) are there?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dm.sha256_digest) AS distinct_external_cnt FROM PYPI.DISTRIBUTION_METADATA dm;

question: I want to roughly see the deduplication scale of distribution package dependency declarations (requires_dist): how many distinct dependency declaration sets are there (deduplicated by requires_dist)?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dm.requires_dist) AS distinct_entity_cnt FROM PYPI.DISTRIBUTION_METADATA dm;

question: I want to find the most common “dependency template”: which sets of requires_dist dependency declarations appear most frequently in distributions? Give me the top 10.
SQL: SELECT dm.requires_dist AS rel_entity, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM PYPI.DISTRIBUTION_METADATA dm GROUP BY dm.requires_dist ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: In the PyPI distribution metadata, I want to see which package names have the most published artifacts: count the distribution by name, what are the Top 10?
SQL: SELECT dm.name AS name_entity, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM PYPI.DISTRIBUTION_METADATA dm GROUP BY dm.name ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: In PyPI distribution package metadata, I want to search by package name keyword (e.g., "safa") and see which distribution artifacts (sha256_digest) correspond to the matched packages. First give me the top 10 artifact fingerprints.
SQL: SELECT distinct dm.sha256_digest AS id_external FROM PYPI.DISTRIBUTION_METADATA dm WHERE dm.name LIKE '%safa%' ORDER BY dm.sha256_digest LIMIT 10;

question: I would like to see the distribution of distribution artifacts across the repository path (path) dimension: which paths have the highest number of distinct artifact fingerprints (deduplicated by sha256_digest)? Show me the Top 10.
SQL: SELECT dm.path AS location, COUNT(DISTINCT dm.sha256_digest) AS distinct_external_cnt FROM PYPI.DISTRIBUTION_METADATA dm GROUP BY dm.path ORDER BY distinct_external_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;
